items.q: What time are Minnesota Lottery drawings held?
items.a: Draw times vary by game; times on this page use Minnesota local time (CT). See the Schedule section.

items.q: What is the minimum age to play the Minnesota Lottery?
items.a: You must be 18 or older to play.
Minnesota withholds state income tax on lottery winnings, in addition to federal tax. Federal withholding of 24% applies to prizes over $5,000.

items.q: How do I claim a Minnesota Lottery prize?
items.a: Smaller prizes at retailers; larger prizes at a claim center or headquarters. See How to Claim above.

items.q: What happens to unclaimed Minnesota Lottery prizes?
items.a: Unclaimed prize funds are directed to state programs per Minnesota Lottery rules.

items.q: What are today's Minnesota Lottery numbers?
items.a: The latest winning numbers for all games appear in the Latest Draw Results section above.

items.q: How do I check my Minnesota Lottery ticket?
items.a: Compare your numbers to the Latest Draw Results and complete official validation before claiming.
See the Jackpot Tracker below for whether top prizes rolled over and the next estimated jackpots.
